name: ilangathirtrust-platform
description: Ilangathir Trust full-stack multilingual web platform, secure admin portal, and Supabase/Razorpay API

scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB,ADMIN -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web" "npm run dev -w apps/admin"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/admin
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web && npm run typecheck -w apps/admin
